prompts.swept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game hardware sprite source sheet, design candidate only. Create a transparent-background 2 by 2 sprite sheet of FOUR separate top-down orthographic large swept 90-degree waveguide elbows: upper left connects WEST to SOUTH; upper right WEST to NORTH; lower left NORTH to EAST; lower right EAST to SOUTH. Each piece has exactly two uncapped flat connection ends, constant narrow cross-section, generous quarter-circle bend radius 4 times the casing width; no terminal collars or black mouths. Style matches the supplied reference image: restrained ivory ceramic center in dark charcoal metal casing, narrow brushed grey edge, small copper mechanical detail only inside bend, practical factory hardware, crisp game-scale legibility, no glow. More detailed physical surface than the reference but preserve its plain industrial language. All four pieces are authored with fixed light from screen upper left, not rotated lighting. Each occupies an equal square cell with large transparent separation; no shadows outside casing, no perspective, no text, no grid, no labels, no arrows. These are BASIC tier only. Reference image is style reference only, not an edit target. All four corners visibly different, broad round sweep rather than right-angle block.
prompts.entities: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: physical waveguide hardware art source sheet. Generate a transparent background sheet with THREE rows and FOUR columns, twelve isolated square top-down orthographic hardware bodies with generous gutters. Match the supplied reference style: ivory ceramic channels, dark graphite casing, muted steel trim and limited copper hardware, fixed upper-left world lighting in every orientation. Row 1 BASIC FOUR PORT HYBRID JUNCTION: one square closed central housing with exactly four uncapped narrow guide terminals. At rotation 0 left column: two terminals on LEFT side at one-quarter and three-quarter height, and two terminals on RIGHT side at one-quarter and three-quarter height; NO top or bottom terminal. Columns 2,3,4 are geometry rotations clockwise 90,180,270 degrees, independently lit. Row 2 MATCHED PRECISION JUNCTION: identical terminal geometry, center body has modest copper reinforcement to distinguish precision. Row 3 TWO LAYER CROSSING: exactly the same offset two-per-side terminal layout, two continuous parallel independent ivory guide channels from left to right at quarter and three-quarter height in first column. Upper channel rises over an internal support bridge at center, lower channel remains independent. NO central joining hub and NO third or fourth channel. Remaining columns rotate geometry 90,180,270 degrees with lighting staying upper-left. All terminals end flat, constant same width, without dark mouths or caps or sleeves. No perspective, no ground shadow outside footprint, no text, no labels, no arrows, no grid. This is an art source sheet, not a pixel-exact runtime atlas; keep each sprite isolated.
